name: metrica
description: A triathlon training app for IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 athletes: race guides, World Championship qualification, fueling targets, a 16-week 70.3 plan, and the athlete's own metrica training plan.

interface.longDescription:
metrica is a triathlon training app for IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 athletes. It answers race questions with metrica.fit's own race data, gives you a 16-week IRONMAN 70.3 training plan, and builds and adjusts your own metrica training plan with you.

Race guides: swim, bike and run distances and elevation, typical race-day weather from a 10-year climatology (air and water temperature, wind, how likely a wetsuit-legal swim is), per-hour fueling targets and World Championship slots, plus approximate GPX course files.

Qualification: who qualified for the IRONMAN World Championship or the 70.3 World Championship at an event, age-graded times, the qualifying time in each age group and how slot rolldown played out.

Fueling: per-hour carbohydrate, sodium and fluid targets for a race, scaled by finish time, heat and body mass.

Training plan: the 16-week IRONMAN 70.3 plan at about 7, 10 or 13 hours a week: three recovery weeks, a two-week taper, and every session with its duration and what to do. Name a 70.3 race and it is dated back from race day and adjusted for that course's climbing, heat and water; give a date and it is dated for any race. The plan opens as an interactive view where you can switch the weekly hours, open any week and add the sessions to your calendar.

Your own training: with a metrica account the same app sets up your plan and runs it with you. It checks what your account is missing, saves the benchmarks and races you give it, and builds your season outline and each week's workouts, always previewing first and replacing nothing until you confirm. Day to day it shows today's workout and the week, builds or reworks a session from a plain description, moves or removes one, and sends it to Garmin or Wahoo. It also reads your fitness, fatigue and form, your WHOOP or Keely recovery and sleep, and how your week went against the plan, and logs a check-in or food entry when you ask. The first time, it asks you to sign in to metrica.

Limitations: the 16-week plan covers the 70.3 (half) distance only; plan builds take one to ten minutes and run in the background. Weather is a climatology, not a forecast. Qualification is modelled from official results with the published age-group multipliers; confirm against the official allocation. The plan is a general plan for healthy adults, not medical advice. Race data and the 16-week 70.3 plan work without a metrica account. metrica is not affiliated with or endorsed by the IRONMAN Group.
defaultPrompt: Give me a 16-week plan for IRONMAN 70.3 Boulder at 8 hours a week
What are the typical race-day conditions at IRONMAN 70.3 Nice?
What were the Kona qualifying times for M40-44 at IRONMAN Texas?

positive.description: Dated 70.3 plan for a named race
positive.prompt: Give me a 16-week plan for IRONMAN 70.3 Boulder at 8 hours a week
positive.expected_behavior: A 16-week plan dated back from race day (12 Jun 2027), the ~7-hour version, with course notes and the interactive plan view with a calendar link.

positive.description: Race-day conditions from a race guide
positive.prompt: What are typical race-day conditions at IRONMAN 70.3 Nice?
positive.expected_behavior: Air and water temperature, wind and how likely a wetsuit-legal swim is, from the guide's 10-year climatology, with a link to the guide.

positive.prompt: What were the Kona qualifying times for M40-44 at IRONMAN Texas?
positive.expected_behavior: The qualifying time and the qualifiers for M40-44 at that edition, with the slot rolldown.

positive.description: Signed-in: today's workout and the week
positive.prompt: What's my metrica workout today, and show me my week
positive.expected_behavior: First call starts ChatGPT sign-in (demo account). After it: today's planned session with its steps, and the Monday-Sunday week of the demo plan in the my-week view.

positive.prompt: How did my week go, and how recovered am I?
positive.expected_behavior: Planned against completed sessions per day and discipline for the current week; recovery says no WHOOP or Keely is connected on the demo account.

negative.description: Running-only plan request (not a triathlon question)
negative.prompt: Write me a marathon training plan
Book me a hotel in Nice for race weekend

negative.description: Unsupported distance: only the 70.3 plan exists
negative.prompt: Give me a full-distance IRONMAN plan for Texas

review.commerce_description: metrica does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.
